steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the scheduled service has been done).
Switch the car on. Press the Mode button to step through the cluster display modes until Service mode shows.
Press and hold the OK button for more than 1 second. The countdown restarts at the miles and days that were set before.
Switch off and on again and check that the Service in or Service required message no longer appears.
oil.note: Checked in the 2024 Soul owner's manual. The countdown can be wrong after the battery has been disconnected or run flat.
